title: VisualGroundingSchema
description: JSON schema for visual grounding and Grad-CAM activation artifacts in chest X-ray report generation.

study_id.description: Identifier of the imaging study (e.g., CXR1122).

image_id.description: Identifier of the specific radiograph (e.g., CXR1122_IM-0080-1001-0002).

disclaimer.description: Explanatory disclaimer that visual attribution maps are for research explainability, not clinical diagnosis.

original_image_path.description: Path to preserved original radiograph image.

groundings.description: List of visual grounding entries linked to individual findings.

grounding_records.description: List of visual grounding entries linked to individual findings (alias).

finding.description: Name of the target DenseNet-121 pathology.

model_score.description: Raw vision model score for this pathology (not clinical confidence).

status.description: Evidence status from Evidence Layer (never upgraded by grounding).

target_layer.description: Exact PyTorch module layer where feature maps and gradients were tapped (e.g., model.features.norm5).

activation_shape.description: Spatial dimensions of the convolutional feature map before interpolation (e.g., [7, 7]).

heatmap_shape.description: Spatial dimensions of the upsampled heatmap (e.g., [512, 624]).

normalization.description: Normalization technique applied to the raw activation map.

heatmap_path.description: Path to saved colormapped Grad-CAM heatmap PNG.

overlay_path.description: Path to saved heatmap-radiograph overlay PNG.

notes.description: Explanatory disclaimer (model attention pattern, not clinical localization).
